BUY WITH CONTEXT

Concentration is a clue, not a promise.

EDT, EDP and “Intense” describe formulations, but the labels do not guarantee projection or longevity. Two concentrations in the same line can smell materially different. Test on skin when possible, wait for the dry-down, and compare the exact product name.

Why price per mL?

It makes differently sized bottles comparable. A larger bottle can offer better unit value while still costing more upfront.

Why exclude disliked notes completely?

Your excluded note is a hard filter, not a small scoring penalty. Catalog note lists are selective descriptions, so check the full product page and ingredients if sensitivities matter.

Does a match predict what I will like?

No. It is a transparent similarity score over listed families, notes, occasions and intensity. Skin chemistry, memory and context are not measurable here.
